## Summary

- add an early REST-based eyes reaction immediately after checkout
- derive supported reaction endpoints from the raw event payload
- filter quoted, fenced, inline-code, and unchanged edited mentions
- retain GraphQL fallback for failures, discussions, and PR review bodies
- suppress duplicate reactions across authentication identities
- add focused workflow and helper tests plus documentation

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `npm --prefix .agent run check:workflow`
- `npm --prefix .agent run check:docs`
- `npm --prefix .agent run check:shell`

Closes #465

## Summary of PR/Issue

[PR #466](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/466) implements Task 1b of [#465](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/465), within the first-response milestone [#454](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/454). It adds a dependency-free REST helper that posts an early 👀 acknowledgment before runtime setup. Successful early reactions suppress the later GraphQL reaction, while unsupported surfaces and failures retain the existing fallback. Focused tests and documentation cover endpoint selection, mention filtering, edited events, failure behavior, and workflow ordering.

## Review

The current implementation is surgical, safe, and ship-ready. Reviewers disagreed only about early 👀 reactions on `/approve` commands; the delegated specification intentionally defines the fast path using live mentions, making this non-actionable.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| No unresolved actionable issues | INFO | The implementation satisfies the delegated scope, preserves safe fallback behavior, and passes current-head validation. |

## Progress

- Verified unchanged head `917e6ab1542639cd0ab3c4f6b1a23975d1a744bf`; the PR is mergeable and the `Test Scripts` check is green.
- Confirmed PR #462’s reviewed head is an ancestor of this stacked PR.
- The rubric review passed 100%, and all reviewers found the core implementation safe and appropriately scoped.
- `/approve` comments receive an early 👀 plus the approval workflow’s semantic 👍; this matches the live-mention acceptance criteria rather than duplicating the same reaction.
- No existing inline comments or review threads required deduplication or cleanup. No comments, replies, resolutions, or minimizations were performed.
- Tasks 1c, 2, and 3 remain intentionally out of scope.

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`: No unresolved actionable review work remains on the branch.

## Final Verdict

`SHIP`
